title: Emperor Palpatine
description: It had been Emperor Palpatine all along. As part of a long-term plan, Palpatine had been resurrected by the Sith Eternal on Exegol. He had created Supreme Leader Snoke, and engineered the turning of Ben Solo to Kylo Ren. He planned to take over Rey's body and use the Final Order to retake the galaxy. Fortunately, the combined forces of the Resistance, the Citizens' Fleet, Rey and Ben defeated him.
